arguments.summary: Identified 6 distinct Phoenix retail refinance opportunities maturing between 2026-09-01 and 2027-08-31 with active confirmed loans, executed-note maturities and no executed extensions. Duplicates were deduplicated (R7849/R8920). 14 other records were excluded due to released/unknown-status loans, unconfirmed maturities or unresolved options, stale ownership verification, amendments extending maturity, non-retail or out-of-market assets, or post-cutoff evidence. A prospects CSV with citations for the shortlisted deals has been created (artifacts/prospects-v4.csv).
limitations: Eligibility uses only sources effective on or before the 2026-08-31 cutoff; later changes may alter status.
Duplicate mapping relies on identical entity_id across sources.
Contact eligibility is limited to stated roles and verification dates; no external validation performed.
